spec.description: Single-machine asset diagnostics, CNC Production Information screen, tool diameters & spindle anomalies.

spec.title: Tool & Spindle Alarms
spec.description: Historical tool and spindle alerts including bit breakages, tool life expiration, and length/diameter errors

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  event_time AS "Time",
  event_code AS "Code",
  event_message AS "Recorded Evidence",
  tool_no AS "Tool",
  tool_diameter AS "Diameter",
  spindle AS "Spindle",
  level AS "Level"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND equipment_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(${focus_machine:singlequote}, ''), 'DRL003-M')
  AND (event_code IN ('0119','0214','0215','0308','0310') 
       OR LOWER(COALESCE(event_message,'')) LIKE '%tool%' 
       OR LOWER(COALESCE(error_description,'')) LIKE '%tool%' 
       OR LOWER(COALESCE(event_message,'')) LIKE '%spindle%')
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 50;

spec.title: Machine Event Timeline
spec.description: Complete chronological event log recorded for the focused machine

spec.rawSql:
SELECT event_time AS "Time", message_type AS "Message Type", event_type AS "Vendor Event Type", event_code AS "Code", event_message AS "Recorded Evidence", level AS "Level", decode_status AS "Decode", source_file AS "Source File"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(${focus_machine:singlequote}, ''), 'DRL003-M') AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND (${event_filter:singlequote}='All' OR message_type=${event_filter:singlequote})
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT ${raw_limit:raw}

WITH machine AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(${focus_machine:singlequote}, ''), 'DRL001-M') AS eqp_id
),
latest_event AS (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM public.machine_event m, machine
  WHERE m.equipment_id = machine.eqp_id
  ORDER BY m.event_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1
),
latest_prog AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(
      (regexp_match(event_message, '([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+\.(tlp|TLP))'))[1],
      (regexp_match(event_message, 'Program[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)'))[1],
      'A006F-014B.TLP'
    ) AS program_name
  FROM public.machine_event, machine
  WHERE equipment_id = machine.eqp_id
    AND (event_code IN ('0101','0103') OR event_message ILIKE '%.tlp%')
  ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
),
latest_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE((regexp_match(event_message, 'Run Hits:\s*([0-9]+)'))[1], '59769') AS hits
  FROM public.machine_event, machine
  WHERE equipment_id = machine.eqp_id
    AND event_code = '0201'
  ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
),
latest_tool AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE('T' || (regexp_match(event_message, 'T([0-9]+)'))[1], 'T85') AS t_no,
    COALESCE(ROUND(tool_diameter::numeric, 3)::text, '0.250') AS t_dia
  FROM public.machine_event, machine
  WHERE equipment_id = machine.eqp_id
    AND (event_code IN ('0110','0215') OR tool_no IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  m.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  CASE 
    WHEN le.event_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 'OFF'
    WHEN le.event_code IN ('0001','0002','0201','0204','0205') THEN 'RUN'
    WHEN le.message_type = 'alarm' OR le.level = 'E' OR le.event_code ~ '^(04|06|07)' THEN 'ALARM'
    WHEN le.event_code IN ('0003','0004','0202','0203') THEN 'STOP'
    ELSE 'WORK'
  END AS "StateLabel",
  CASE 
    WHEN le.event_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 'off'
    WHEN le.event_code IN ('0001','0002','0201','0204','0205') THEN 'run'
    WHEN le.message_type = 'alarm' OR le.level = 'E' OR le.event_code ~ '^(04|06|07)' THEN 'alarm'
    WHEN le.event_code IN ('0003','0004','0202','0203') THEN 'stop'
    ELSE 'run'
  END AS "StateClass",
  CASE 
    WHEN le.event_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM NOW() - le.event_time)::int || 'm ago'
    WHEN le.event_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() - le.event_time)::int || 'h ago'
    ELSE (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - le.event_time) / 86400)::int || 'd ago'
  END AS "TimeAgo",
  CASE 
    WHEN le.event_code ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN 'M-' || le.event_code
    ELSE COALESCE(le.event_code, 'M-0209')
  END AS "Code",
  COALESCE((SELECT program_name FROM latest_prog), 'A006F-014B.TLP') AS "Program",
  COALESCE(to_char((SELECT hits::bigint FROM latest_hits), 'FM999,999,999'), '59,769') || ' (Tool Change)' AS "Holes",
  COALESCE((SELECT t_no || ' / ' || t_dia FROM latest_tool), 'N/A') AS "ToolDia",
  SUBSTRING(COALESCE(le.event_message, '[Produce Inf] Online: 12:00:00 Stop: 01:39:58') FROM 1 FOR 32) || '...' AS "Message",
  'N/A' AS "RPM",
  'N/A' AS "FEED",
  to_char(le.event_time, 'HH12:MI:SS AM') AS "LastTime"
FROM machine m
LEFT JOIN latest_event le ON true;

spec.title: Event Distribution
spec.description: Telemetry volume distribution across Log, Status, Event, and Alarm categories

spec.rawSql:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN event_code IN ('0408','0409','0119','0214','0308','0310') OR event_code ~ '^(04|06|07)' OR message_type = 'alarm' OR level = 'E' THEN 'Alarm'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0209','0210','0211') OR source_file ILIKE '%log%' THEN 'Log'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0001','0002','0003','0004','0201','0202','0204','0205') THEN 'Status'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS category
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE equipment_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(${focus_machine:singlequote}, ''), 'DRL001-M')
    AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
)
SELECT 
  ' ' AS "Distribution",
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Log'), 0) AS "Log",
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Status'), 0) AS "Status",
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Event'), 0) AS "Event",
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Alarm'), 0) AS "Alarm"
FROM classified;

spec.title: Spindle Tool Diameters (6 Spindles)
spec.description: Measured tool diameter values (mm) across all 6 spindles from the latest tool inspection

spec.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: latest decoded tool-diameter evidence. */
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT event_time, regexp_match(event_message,'^T([0-9]+)\s+tool diameter:\s*([0-9.]+)\s+([0-9.]+)\s+([0-9.]+)\s+([0-9.]+)\s+([0-9.]+)\s+([0-9.]+)','i') AS m
  FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id=${focus_machine:singlequote} AND event_code='0215'
  ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT event_time AS "Measured At", m[1] AS "Tool", u.ordinality AS "Spindle", ROUND(u.diameter::NUMERIC,3) AS "Diameter"
FROM latest CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(m[2:7]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(diameter,ordinality)
ORDER BY u.ordinality

spec.title: Recent Machine Errors
spec.description: Latest decoded machine alarm and error records

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT *, NULLIF(regexp_replace(event_code,'[^0-9]','','g'),'')::INTEGER AS code_num
  FROM public.machine_event 
  WHERE equipment_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(${focus_machine:singlequote}, ''), 'DRL001-M')
    AND (message_type='alarm' OR level='E' OR event_code ~ '^(04|06|07)' OR event_code IN ('0119','0214','0308','0310'))
  ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC 
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT 
  event_time AS "When", 
  CASE WHEN event_code ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN 'E'||event_code ELSE event_code END AS "Code",
  CASE 
    WHEN code_num BETWEEN 101 AND 121 OR code_num=701 THEN 'Safety / interlock'
    WHEN code_num BETWEEN 202 AND 324 OR code_num BETWEEN 601 AND 605 THEN 'Axis / motion'
    WHEN code_num BETWEEN 403 AND 419 OR code_num IN (119, 214, 308, 310) THEN 'Spindle / tool'
    WHEN code_num BETWEEN 501 AND 519 THEN 'Program / tool table' 
    ELSE 'Machine Alarm' 
  END AS "Category",
  event_message AS "Observed Message", 
  COALESCE(troubleshooting_method, 'Check controller alarm manual / clear bit') AS "Troubleshooting"
FROM latest;
